title.zh: 卷九十六 列傳第二十六: 耶律仁先 耶律良 蕭韓家奴 蕭德 蕭惟信 蕭樂音奴 耶律敵烈 姚景行 耶律阿思
title.en: Volume 96 Biographies 26: Yelu Renxian, Yelu Liang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao De, Xiao Weixin, Xiao Leyinnu, Yelu Dilie, Yao Jingxing, Yelu Asi
title.raw: 卷九十六 列傳第二十六: 耶律仁先 耶律良 蕭韓家奴 蕭德 蕭惟信 蕭樂音奴 耶律敵烈 姚景行 耶律阿思 Volume 96 Biographies 26: Yelu Renxian, Yelu Liang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao De, Xiao Weixin, Xiao Leyinnu, Yelu Dilie, Yao Jingxing, Yelu Asi

sentences.zh: 耶律仁先

translations.literal: Yelu Renxian
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Renxian

sentences.zh: 〈（撻不也）〉

translations.literal: (Tabuye)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Tabuye)〉

sentences.zh: 耶律良蕭韓家奴蕭德蕭惟信蕭樂音奴耶律敵烈姚景行耶律阿思

translations.literal: Yelu Liang; Xiao Hanjianu; Xiao De; Xiao Weixin; Xiao Leyinnu; Yelu Dilie; Yao Jingxing; Yelu Asi
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Liang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao De, Xiao Weixin, Xiao Leyinnu, Yelu Dilie, Yao Jingxing, and Yelu Asi

sentences.zh: 耶律仁先，字糺鄰，小字查剌，孟父房之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Renxian, style name Jiulin, childhood name Chala, was a descendant of the Mengfu line.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Renxian, whose style name was Jiulin and whose childhood name was Chala, was a descendant of the Mengfu line.

sentences.zh: 父瑰引，南府宰相，封燕王。

translations.literal: His father Guiyin was Chancellor of the Southern Office and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Guiyin served as Chancellor of the Southern Office and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yan.

sentences.zh: 仁先魁偉爽秀，有智略。

translations.literal: Renxian was imposing, open, and refined, and possessed strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian was tall and striking in bearing, open and refined in manner, and gifted with strategic insight.

sentences.zh: 重熙三年，補護衛。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chongxi, he was appointed to the guard corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Chongxi reign, he was appointed to the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 帝與論政，才之。

translations.literal: The emperor discussed government with him and recognized his talent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor discussed affairs of state with him and was impressed by his ability.

sentences.zh: 仁先以不世遇，言無所隱。

translations.literal: Renxian, because of this matchless favor, spoke without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Treated with exceptional favor, Renxian spoke his mind without reserve.

sentences.zh: 授宿直將軍，累遷殿前副點檢，改鶴剌唐古部節度使，俄召為北面林牙。

translations.literal: He was appointed Night-Duty General, rose through successive posts to Deputy Commander of the Palace Front, was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Hela Tanggu Tribe, and soon recalled as Northern Chancellor Linya.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Night-Duty General, rose through successive appointments to Deputy Commander of the Palace Front, was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Hela Tanggu Tribe, and was soon recalled to serve as Northern Chancellor Linya.

sentences.zh: 十一年，升北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, he was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, he was promoted to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時宋請增歲幣銀絹以償十縣地產，仁先與劉六符使宋，仍議書「貢」。

translations.literal: At that time Song requested increased annual payments in silver and silk to compensate for the produce of ten counties, and Renxian went on embassy to Song with Liu Liufu, still negotiating that the documents use the word "tribute."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Song court asked to increase the annual payments in silver and silk to compensate for the produce of ten counties. Renxian went on embassy to Song with Liu Liufu, and still pressed that the written agreement use the term "tribute."

sentences.zh: 宋難之。

translations.literal: Song found this difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The Song side objected.

sentences.zh: 仁先曰：「曩者石晉報德本朝，割地以獻，周人攘而取之，是非利害，灼然可見。」

translations.literal: Renxian said, "Formerly the Later Jin repaid our dynasty's kindness and ceded territory in offering; the Zhou seized it by force — right and wrong, gain and loss, are plainly visible."
translations.idiomatic: Renxian said, "In former times the Later Jin repaid our court's kindness and ceded territory as an offering. The Zhou seized it by force. The rights and wrongs, the gains and losses, are plain for all to see."

sentences.zh: 宋無辭以對。

translations.literal: Song had no words with which to reply.
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoys had no answer.

sentences.zh: 乃定議增銀、絹十萬兩、匹，仍稱「貢」。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was settled to increase silver and silk by one hundred thousand taels and bolts, still using the term "tribute."
translations.idiomatic: An agreement was then reached to add one hundred thousand taels of silver and bolts of silk, while still calling the payments "tribute."

sentences.zh: 既還，同知南京留守事。

translations.literal: After returning, he became co-administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made co-administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.

sentences.zh: 十三年，伐夏，留仁先鎮邊。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when an expedition was launched against Xia, Renxian was left to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, during the campaign against Xia, Renxian was left to hold the frontier.

sentences.zh: 未幾，召為契丹行宮都部署，奏復王子班郎君及諸宮雜役。

translations.literal: Before long he was recalled as Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace and memorialized to restore the Prince's Class of Attendant Gentlemen and the miscellaneous services of the various palaces.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was recalled as Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace and memorialized for the restoration of the Prince's Class of Attendant Gentlemen and the miscellaneous palace services.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遷北院大王，奏今兩院戶口殷庶，乞免他部助役，從之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to Great King of the Northern Court and memorialized that the households of both courts were now numerous and prosperous, requesting exemption from corvée assistance by other departments; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was transferred to Great King of the Northern Court. He memorialized that the registered households of both courts had grown numerous and prosperous and asked that they be exempted from corvée assistance levied by other departments; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十八年，再舉伐夏，仁先與皇太弟重元為前鋒。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when another expedition against Xia was launched, Renxian and the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when another campaign against Xia was launched, Renxian and the Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan served as the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 蕭惠失利於河南，帝猶欲進兵，仁先力諫，乃止。

translations.literal: Xiao Hui suffered defeat south of the Yellow River, yet the emperor still wished to advance; Renxian strongly remonstrated, and the advance was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hui suffered defeat south of the Yellow River, yet the emperor still wished to press forward. Renxian remonstrated forcefully, and the advance was halted.

sentences.zh: 後知北院樞密使，遷東京留守。

translations.literal: Later he served as Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 女直恃險，侵掠不止，仁先乞開山通道以控制之，邊民安業。

translations.literal: The Jurchen relied on rugged terrain and raided without cease; Renxian requested that mountain roads be opened to control them, and the frontier people lived in peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen, trusting in difficult terrain, raided without cease. Renxian asked that mountain passes be opened and roads built to bring them under control, and the frontier people were able to live in peace.

sentences.zh: 封吳王。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: Early in Qingning, he became Commissioner of the Southern Court Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qingning reign he became Commissioner of the Southern Court Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以耶律化哥譖，出為南京兵馬副元帥，守太尉，更王隋。

translations.literal: Because of Yelu Huage's slander, he was sent out as Deputy Marshal of the Southern Capital armies and horses, held the office of Defender Grandee, and was reassigned as Prince of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Because of Yelu Huage's slander he was sent out as Deputy Marshal of the Southern Capital armies and horses, held the office of Defender Grandee, and was reassigned as Prince of Sui.

sentences.zh: 六年，復為北院大王，民歡迎數百里，如見父兄。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again became Great King of the Northern Court; the people welcomed him for hundreds of li as though seeing a father or elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he again became Great King of the Northern Court. The people came out to welcome him for hundreds of li, as though greeting a father or elder brother.

sentences.zh: 時北、南院樞密官涅魯古、蕭胡睹等忌之，請以仁先為西北路招討使。

translations.literal: At that time the Secretariat officials Nielugu and Xiao Huzhu of the Northern and Southern courts envied him and requested that Renxian be made Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Secretariat officials Nielugu and Xiao Huzhu of the Northern and Southern courts envied him and asked that Renxian be appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 耶律乙辛奏曰：「仁先舊臣，德冠一時，不宜補外。」

translations.literal: Yelu Yixin memorialized, "Renxian is an old minister whose virtue surpasses all in his age; he should not be posted abroad."
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Yixin memorialized, "Renxian is a veteran minister whose virtue surpasses all others of his day. He should not be sent out to a frontier post."

sentences.zh: 復拜南院樞密使，更王許。

translations.literal: He was again appointed Commissioner of the Southern Court Secretariat and reassigned as Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: He was again appointed Commissioner of the Southern Court Secretariat and reassigned as Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，上獵太子山，耶律良奏重元謀逆，帝召仁先語之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year, when the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi, Yelu Liang reported that Chongyuan was plotting rebellion; the emperor summoned Renxian and told him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year, while the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi, Yelu Liang reported that Chongyuan was plotting rebellion. The emperor summoned Renxian and told him of it.

sentences.zh: 仁先曰：「此曹凶狠，臣固疑之久矣。」

translations.literal: Renxian said, "This crew is fierce and cruel; your servant has long suspected them."
translations.idiomatic: Renxian said, "That crew is fierce and cruel. Your servant has suspected them for a long time."

sentences.zh: 帝趣仁先捕之。

translations.literal: The emperor urged Renxian to seize them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor urged Renxian to arrest them at once.

sentences.zh: 仁先出，且曰：「陛下宜謹為之備！」

translations.literal: Renxian went out, saying as he did so, "Your Majesty should take careful precautions!"
translations.idiomatic: Renxian went out, adding as he left, "Your Majesty must take careful precautions!"

sentences.zh: 未及介馬，重元犯帷宮。

translations.literal: Before he could mount, Chongyuan attacked the curtained palace.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could even mount his horse, Chongyuan struck at the curtained imperial encampment.

sentences.zh: 帝欲幸北、南院，仁先曰：「陛下若舍扈從而行，賊必躡其後；

translations.literal: The emperor wished to go to the Northern and Southern courts; Renxian said, "If Your Majesty abandons your escort and goes alone, the rebels will surely follow close behind;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to go to the Northern and Southern courts. Renxian said, "If Your Majesty leaves your escort and goes alone, the rebels will surely follow close behind;

sentences.zh: 且南、北大王心未可知。」

translations.literal: moreover, the hearts of the Great Kings of the Northern and Southern courts cannot yet be known."
translations.idiomatic: moreover, the loyalty of the Great Kings of the Northern and Southern courts cannot yet be known."

sentences.zh: 仁先子撻不也曰：「聖意豈可違乎？」

translations.literal: Renxian's son Tabuye said, "How can the sacred will be disobeyed?"
translations.idiomatic: Renxian's son Tabuye said, "How can the sacred will be disobeyed?"

sentences.zh: 仁先怒，擊其首。

translations.literal: Renxian grew angry and struck him on the head.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian flew into a rage and struck him on the head.

sentences.zh: 帝悟，悉委仁先以討賊事。

translations.literal: The emperor understood and entrusted the entire suppression of the rebels to Renxian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor understood and entrusted the entire campaign against the rebels to Renxian.

sentences.zh: 乃環車為營，拆行馬，作兵仗，率官屬近侍三十餘騎陣柢枑外。

translations.literal: Thereupon he ringed the carts into a camp, dismantled the traveling horses, fashioned weapons, and led more than thirty mounted officials and close attendants to form a battle line outside the barrier posts.
translations.idiomatic: He then ringed the carts into a camp, dismantled the traveling horses to make weapons, and led more than thirty mounted officials and close attendants to form a battle line outside the barrier posts.

sentences.zh: 及交戰，賊眾多降。

translations.literal: When battle was joined, many of the rebels surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Once battle was joined, many of the rebels surrendered.

sentences.zh: 涅魯古中矢墮馬，擒之，重元被傷而退。

translations.literal: Nielugu was struck by an arrow, fell from his horse, and was captured; Chongyuan was wounded and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Nielugu was struck by an arrow, fell from his horse, and was captured. Chongyuan was wounded and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 仁先以五院部蕭塔剌所居最近，亟召之，分遣人集諸軍。

translations.literal: Renxian, because Xiao Tala of the Five Courts Division lived nearest, urgently summoned him and sent men in different directions to gather the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xiao Tala of the Five Courts Division lived nearest, Renxian urgently summoned him and dispatched men in every direction to gather the armies.

sentences.zh: 黎明，重元率奚人二千犯行宮，蕭塔剌兵適至。

translations.literal: At dawn Chongyuan led two thousand Xi men in an attack on the traveling palace, and Xiao Tala's troops arrived just in time.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn Chongyuan led two thousand Xi men in an assault on the traveling palace, and Xiao Tala's troops arrived just in time.

sentences.zh: 仁先料賊勢不能久，俟其氣沮攻之。

translations.literal: Renxian judged that the rebel force could not hold long and waited until their spirit flagged before attacking.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian judged that the rebel force could not endure long and waited until their spirit flagged before attacking.

sentences.zh: 乃背營而陣，乘便奮擊，賊眾奔潰，追殺二十餘里，重元與數騎遁去。

translations.literal: Thereupon he drew up his line with the camp at his back, struck hard at an opportune moment, the rebels broke and fled, and they were pursued and slain for more than twenty li; Chongyuan escaped with a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: He then drew up his line with the camp at his back, struck hard when the moment favored him, and the rebels broke and fled. The pursuit continued for more than twenty li, and Chongyuan escaped with only a few horsemen.

sentences.zh: 帝執仁先手曰：「平亂皆卿之功也。」

translations.literal: The emperor took Renxian's hand and said, "The pacification of the rebellion is entirely your achievement."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took Renxian by the hand and said, "The pacification of this rebellion is entirely your achievement."

sentences.zh: 加尚父，進封宋王，為北院樞密使，親制文以褒之，詔畫《灤河戰圖》以旌其功。

translations.literal: He was given the exalted title Imperial Father, advanced to Prince of Song, made Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat, personally composed a text to praise him, and ordered that the 《Battle Picture of the Luan River》 be painted to honor his merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the exalted title Imperial Father, advanced to Prince of Song, and made Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat. The emperor personally composed a text in his praise and ordered that the 《Battle Picture of the Luan River》 be painted to honor his merit.

sentences.zh: 咸雍元年，加於越，改封遼王，與耶律乙辛共知北院樞密事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianyong he was given the title yuyue, reassigned as Prince of Liao, and jointly administered Northern Court Secretariat affairs with Yelu Yixin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Xianyong reign he was given the title yuyue, reassigned as Prince of Liao, and jointly administered Northern Court Secretariat affairs with Yelu Yixin.

sentences.zh: 乙辛恃寵不法，仁先抑之，由是見忌，出為南京留守，改王晉。

translations.literal: Yixin relied on favor and acted lawlessly; Renxian restrained him and on that account was resented, sent out as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital, and reassigned as Prince of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin relied on imperial favor and acted lawlessly. Renxian restrained him, and on that account was resented, sent out as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital, and reassigned as Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 恤孤惸，禁奸慝，宋聞風震服。

translations.literal: He cared for orphans and the solitary, forbade wickedness and evil, and when Song heard of it they were awed into submission.
translations.idiomatic: He cared for orphans and the destitute, forbade wickedness and evil, and when Song heard of his conduct they were awed into submission.

sentences.zh: 議者以為自於越休哥之後，惟仁先一人而已。

translations.literal: Commentators held that since yuyue Xiuge, Renxian alone had been such a man.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held that since Yelu Xiuge as yuyue, Renxian alone had been such a man.

sentences.zh: 阻卜塔裏幹叛命，仁先為西北路招討使，賜鷹紐印及劍。

translations.literal: When the Zubu chieftain Taligan rebelled, Renxian was made Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit and granted an eagle-button seal and a sword.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zubu chieftain Taligan rebelled, Renxian was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit and granted an eagle-button seal and a sword.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「卿去朝廷遠，每俟奏行，恐失機會，可便宜從事。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed him, saying, "You are far from court; if you wait for memorials and orders on every matter, you may miss opportunities. You may act at discretion."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed him, saying, "You are far from court. If you wait for memorials and orders on every matter, you may miss your chance. You may act at discretion."

sentences.zh: 仁先嚴斥候，扼敵沖，懷柔服從，庶事整飭。

translations.literal: Renxian strictly posted scouts, blocked the enemy's thrusts, treated the compliant with kindness, and put all affairs in good order.
translations.idiomatic: Renxian strictly posted scouts, blocked the enemy's thrusts, treated those who submitted with kindness, and put all affairs in good order.

sentences.zh: 塔裏幹復來寇，仁先逆擊，追殺八十餘里。

translations.literal: Taligan came raiding again; Renxian met him in counterattack and pursued, killing for more than eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: Taligan came raiding again. Renxian met him in counterattack and pursued the enemy for more than eighty li.

sentences.zh: 大軍繼至，又敗之。

translations.literal: When the main army arrived it again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, it again defeated them.

sentences.zh: 別部把裏斯、禿沒等來救，見其屢挫，不敢戰而降。

translations.literal: Subordinate divisions Balisi, Tumo, and others came to the rescue; seeing repeated defeats, they did not dare fight and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate divisions under Balisi, Tumo, and others came to the rescue, but seeing repeated defeats they did not dare fight and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 北邊遂安。

translations.literal: The northern frontier was thus pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The northern frontier was thus pacified.

sentences.zh: 八年卒，年六十，遺命家人薄葬。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he died, aged sixty, and left instructions that his family bury him simply.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he died at the age of sixty and left instructions that his family bury him simply.

sentences.zh: 弟義先、信先，俱有傳。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Yixian and Xinxian both have separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers Yixian and Xinxian both have separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 子撻不也。

translations.literal: His son was Tabuye.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Tabuye.

sentences.zh: 撻不也，字胡獨堇。

translations.literal: Tabuye, style name Hudujin.
translations.idiomatic: Tabuye, whose style name was Hudujin.

sentences.zh: 清寧二年，補祗候郎君，累遷永興宮使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingning he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and rose through successive posts to Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Qingning reign he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and rose through successive appointments to Commissioner of the Yongxing Palace.

sentences.zh: 以平重元之亂，遙授忠正軍節度使，賜定亂功臣，同知殿前點檢司事。

translations.literal: For pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion he was appointed in absentia Military Commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, granted the title Meritorious Pacifier of Disorder, and made co-administrator of the Palace Front Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: For his part in pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion he was appointed in absentia Military Commissioner of the Zhongzheng Army, granted the title Meritorious Pacifier of Disorder, and made co-administrator of the Palace Front Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 歷高陽、臨海二軍節度使、左皮室詳穩。

translations.literal: He served successively as Military Commissioner of the Gaoyang and Linhai armies and as Xiangwen of the Left Pishi.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as Military Commissioner of the Gaoyang and Linhai armies and as Xiangwen of the Left Pishi.

sentences.zh: 大康六年，授西北路招討使，率諸部酋長入朝，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Dakang he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, led the chieftains of the various tribes to court, and was additionally made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Dakang reign he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, led the chieftains of the various tribes to court, and was additionally made Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 自蕭敵祿為招討之後，朝廷務姑息，多擇柔願者用之，諸部漸至跋扈。

translations.literal: After Xiao Dilu served as Pacification Commissioner, the court pursued indulgence and often chose the mild and compliant for the post, and the tribes gradually grew overbearing.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiao Dilu held the pacification commission, the court pursued a policy of indulgence and often chose the mild and compliant for the post, and the tribes gradually grew overbearing.

sentences.zh: 撻不也含容尤甚，邊防益廢，尋改西南面招討使。

translations.literal: Tabuye was especially indulgent, frontier defense grew still more neglected, and he was soon transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Tabuye was especially indulgent, frontier defense grew still more neglected, and he was soon transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 阻卜酋長磨古斯來侵，西北路招討使何魯掃古戰不利，詔撻不也代之。

translations.literal: The Zubu chieftain Mogusi came to raid; the Northwest Pacification Commissioner Helu Saogu fought unsuccessfully, and an edict ordered Tabuye to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The Zubu chieftain Mogusi came raiding. The Northwest Pacification Commissioner Helu Saogu fought without success, and an edict ordered Tabuye to replace him.

sentences.zh: 磨古斯之為酋長，由撻不也所薦，至是遣人誘致之。

translations.literal: Mogusi had become chieftain on Tabuye's recommendation; on this occasion Tabuye sent men to lure him in.
translations.idiomatic: Mogusi had become chieftain on Tabuye's recommendation. On this occasion Tabuye sent men to lure him in.

sentences.zh: 磨古斯紿降，撻不也逆於鎮州西南沙磧間，禁士卒無得妄動。

translations.literal: Mogusi feigned surrender; Tabuye went out to meet him between Zhenzhou and the sandy wastes to the southwest and forbade the soldiers to move rashly.
translations.idiomatic: Mogusi feigned surrender. Tabuye went out to meet him in the sandy wastes southwest of Zhenzhou and forbade his soldiers to move rashly.

sentences.zh: 敵至，裨將耶律綰斯、徐烈見其勢銳，不及戰而走，遂被害，年五十八。

translations.literal: When the enemy arrived, the lieutenant generals Yelu Wansi and Xu Lie saw their force was sharp, fled without fighting, and Tabuye was killed; he was fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy arrived, the lieutenant generals Yelu Wansi and Xu Lie saw how fierce their force was, fled without fighting, and Tabuye was killed. He was fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈兼侍中，謚曰貞憫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Secretariat, with posthumous title Zhenmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Vice Director of the Secretariat, with the posthumous title Zhenmin.

sentences.zh: 撻不也少謹願，後為族嫠婦所惑，出其妻，終以無子。

translations.literal: Tabuye was cautious and compliant in youth, but later was beguiled by a widowed kinswoman, drove out his wife, and in the end had no sons.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Tabuye was cautious and compliant, but later he was beguiled by a widowed kinswoman, drove out his wife, and in the end had no sons.

sentences.zh: 人以此譏之。

translations.literal: People mocked him for this.
translations.idiomatic: People mocked him for it.

sentences.zh: 耶律良，字習撚，小字蘇，著帳郎君之後。

translations.literal: Yelu Liang, style name Sinian, childhood name Su, was a descendant of the Registered-Tent Attendant Gentleman line.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Liang, whose style name was Sinian and whose childhood name was Su, was a descendant of the Registered-Tent Attendant Gentleman line.

sentences.zh: 生於乾州，讀書醫巫閭山。

translations.literal: Born in Qianzhou, he studied on Mount Yiwulü.
translations.idiomatic: Born in Qianzhou, he studied on Mount Yiwulü.

sentences.zh: 學既博，將入南山肄業，友人止之曰：「爾無仆禦，驅馳千里，縱聞見過人，年亦垂暮。

translations.literal: When his learning was already broad, he was about to enter the southern mountains to pursue his studies; a friend stopped him, saying, "You have no servant or carriage; to gallop a thousand li — even if your knowledge surpasses others, your years are already near their end.
translations.idiomatic: When his learning was already broad, he was about to enter the southern mountains to continue his studies. A friend stopped him, saying, "You have no servant or carriage. To travel a thousand li — even if your learning surpasses others, your years are already near their end.

sentences.zh: 今若即仕，已有餘地。」

translations.literal: If you take office now, you already have room enough."
translations.idiomatic: If you take office now, you already have ample scope for achievement."

sentences.zh: 良曰：「窮通命也，非爾所知。」

translations.literal: Liang said, "Failure and success are a matter of fate — not something you can know."
translations.idiomatic: Liang said, "Failure and success are a matter of fate — not something you can know."

sentences.zh: 不聽，留數年而歸。

translations.literal: He would not listen, remained several years, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He would not listen, remained several years, and then returned.

sentences.zh: 重熙中，補寢殿小底，尋為燕趙國王近侍。

translations.literal: During Chongxi he was appointed junior attendant of the sleeping hall and soon became a close attendant of the Prince of Yan and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongxi reign he was appointed junior attendant of the sleeping hall and soon became a close attendant of the Prince of Yan and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 以家貧，詔乘廄馬。

translations.literal: Because his family was poor, an edict allowed him to ride stable horses.
translations.idiomatic: Because his family was poor, an edict allowed him to ride horses from the imperial stables.

sentences.zh: 遷修起居註。

translations.literal: He was transferred to compiler of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to compiler of the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 會獵秋山，良進《秋遊賦》，上嘉之。

translations.literal: When the emperor was hunting at Autumn Mountain, Liang presented the 《Rhapsody on an Autumn Outing》, and the emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was hunting at Autumn Mountain, Liang presented his 《Rhapsody on an Autumn Outing》, and the emperor praised it.

sentences.zh: 清寧中，上幸鴨子河，作《捕魚賦》。

translations.literal: During Qingning, when the emperor visited Duck River, Liang composed the 《Rhapsody on Fishing》.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingning reign, when the emperor visited Duck River, Liang composed his 《Rhapsody on Fishing》.

sentences.zh: 由是寵遇稍隆，遷知制誥，兼知部署司事。

translations.literal: From this his favor rose somewhat; he was transferred to Drafting Edicts and concurrently administered the Deployment Office.
translations.idiomatic: From this his favor grew, and he was transferred to Drafting Edicts with concurrent charge of the Deployment Office.

sentences.zh: 奏請編御製詩文，目曰《清寧集》；

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting compilation of the emperor's poems and prose, to be titled the 《Qingning Collection》;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized requesting that the emperor's poems and prose be compiled under the title 《Qingning Collection》;

sentences.zh: 上命良詩為《慶會集》，親制其序。

translations.literal: the emperor ordered Liang's poems to form the 《Celebratory Assembly Collection》 and personally composed its preface.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor ordered that Liang's poems form the 《Celebratory Assembly Collection》 and personally composed its preface.

sentences.zh: 頃之，為敦睦宮使，兼權知皇太后宮諸局事。

translations.literal: Before long he became Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace and concurrently held acting charge of the various bureaus of the Empress Dowager's palace.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he became Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace and concurrently held acting charge of the various bureaus of the Empress Dowager's palace.

sentences.zh: 良聞重元與子涅魯古謀亂，以帝篤於親愛，不敢遽奏，密言於皇太后。

translations.literal: Liang heard that Chongyuan and his son Nielugu were plotting rebellion; because the emperor was deeply devoted to his kin, he did not dare report it at once and spoke secretly to the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Liang heard that Chongyuan and his son Nielugu were plotting rebellion. Because the emperor was deeply devoted to his kin, he did not dare report it at once and spoke secretly to the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 太皇托疾，召帝白其事。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager feigned illness and summoned the emperor to inform him of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager feigned illness and summoned the emperor to tell him of the plot.

sentences.zh: 帝謂良曰：「汝欲間我骨肉耶？」

translations.literal: The emperor said to Liang, "Do you wish to set my flesh and blood against one another?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to Liang, "Do you wish to set my own flesh and blood against one another?"

sentences.zh: 良奏曰：「臣若妄言，甘伏斧锧。

translations.literal: Liang memorialized, "If your servant speaks falsely, I willingly submit to the axe.
translations.idiomatic: Liang replied, "If your servant speaks falsely, I willingly submit to the axe.

sentences.zh: 陛下不早備，恐墮賊計。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty does not prepare early, I fear you will fall into the rebels' plot.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty does not prepare early, I fear you will fall into the rebels' trap.

sentences.zh: 如召涅魯古不來，可卜其事。」

translations.literal: If Nielugu is summoned and does not come, the matter can be tested."
translations.idiomatic: If Nielugu is summoned and does not come, that will prove the matter."

sentences.zh: 帝從其言。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 使者及門，涅魯古意欲害之，羈於帳下。

translations.literal: When the envoy reached the gate, Nielugu intended to kill him and detained him under the tent.
translations.idiomatic: When the envoy reached the gate, Nielugu intended to kill him and detained him in the tent.

sentences.zh: 使者以佩刀斷帟而出，馳至行宮，以狀聞。

translations.literal: The envoy cut through the tent hangings with his belt knife and fled out, galloped to the traveling palace, and reported the situation.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy cut through the tent hangings with his belt knife, fled out, galloped to the traveling palace, and reported what had happened.

sentences.zh: 帝始信。

translations.literal: Only then did the emperor believe.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did the emperor believe.

sentences.zh: 亂平，以功遷漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: When the rebellion was pacified, for his merit he was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Han Traveling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebellion was pacified, he was transferred for his merit to Garrison Commander of the Han Traveling Palace.

sentences.zh: 咸雍初，同知南院樞密使事，為惕隱，出知中京留守事。

translations.literal: Early in Xianyong he became co-administrator of the Southern Court Secretariat, served as Tiyin, and was sent out to administer the Central Capital garrison command.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianyong reign he became co-administrator of the Southern Court Secretariat, served as Tiyin, and was sent out to administer the Central Capital garrison command.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒，帝嗟悼，遣重臣賻祭，給葬具，追封遼西郡王，謚曰忠成。

translations.literal: Before long he died; the emperor sighed in grief, sent high ministers with funeral gifts and libations, provided burial goods, and posthumously enfeoffed him as Prince of Liaoxi with posthumous title Zhongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died. The emperor sighed in grief, sent high ministers with funeral gifts and libations, provided burial goods, and posthumously enfeoffed him as Prince of Liaoxi with the posthumous title Zhongcheng.

sentences.zh: 蕭韓家奴，字括寧，奚長渤魯恩之後。

translations.literal: Xiao Hanjianu, style name Kuoning, was a descendant of the Xi chieftain Boluen.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hanjianu, whose style name was Kuoning, was a descendant of the Xi chieftain Boluen.

sentences.zh: 性孝友。

translations.literal: By nature he was filial and brotherly.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was filial and devoted to his brothers.

sentences.zh: 太平中，補祗候郎君，累遷敦睦宮使。

translations.literal: During Taiping he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and rose through successive posts to Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping reign he was appointed Attendant Gentleman and rose through successive appointments to Commissioner of the Dunmu Palace.

sentences.zh: 伐夏，為左翼都監，遷北面林牙。

translations.literal: On the campaign against Xia he served as Left Wing Commander-in-Chief and was transferred to Northern Chancellor Linya.
translations.idiomatic: On the campaign against Xia he served as Left Wing Commander-in-Chief and was transferred to Northern Chancellor Linya.

sentences.zh: 俄為南院副部署，賜玉帶，改奚六部大王，治有聲。

translations.literal: Soon he became Deputy Garrison Commander of the Southern Court, was granted a jade belt, was transferred to Great King of the Six Xi Tribes, and his governance won renown.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became Deputy Garrison Commander of the Southern Court, was granted a jade belt, was transferred to Great King of the Six Xi Tribes, and his governance won renown.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，封韓國公，歷南京統軍使、北院宣徽使，封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: Early in Qingning he was enfeoffed as Duke of Han, served as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital armies, and as Commissioner of the Northern Court Imperial Household, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qingning reign he was enfeoffed as Duke of Han, served as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital armies and as Commissioner of the Northern Court Imperial Household, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 九年，上獵太子山，聞重元亂，馳詣行在。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi and heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, he galloped to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when the emperor was hunting at Mount Taizi and heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, he galloped to the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 帝倉卒欲避於北、南大王院，與耶律仁先執轡固諫，乃止。

translations.literal: The emperor in haste wished to flee to the courts of the Northern and Southern Great Kings; together with Yelu Renxian he seized the reins and firmly remonstrated, and the emperor stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, taken by surprise, wished to flee to the courts of the Northern and Southern Great Kings. Together with Yelu Renxian, Hanjianu seized the reins and remonstrated firmly, and the emperor abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 明旦，重元復誘奚獵夫來。

translations.literal: At dawn the next day, Chongyuan again induced Xi hunters to come.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day, Chongyuan again induced Xi hunters to come against the court.

sentences.zh: 韓家奴獨出諭之曰：「汝曹去順效逆，徒取族滅。

translations.literal: Hanjianu went out alone and instructed them, saying, "You abandon obedience and follow rebellion — you will only bring extermination upon your clans.
translations.idiomatic: Hanjianu went out alone and addressed them, saying, "You abandon loyalty and follow rebellion — you will only bring extermination upon your clans.

sentences.zh: 何若悔過，轉禍為福！」

translations.literal: Why not repent and turn misfortune into blessing!"
translations.idiomatic: Why not repent and turn disaster into blessing!"

sentences.zh: 獵夫投仗首服。

translations.literal: The hunters cast down their weapons and submitted with bowed heads.
translations.idiomatic: The hunters cast down their weapons and submitted with bowed heads.

sentences.zh: 以功遷殿前都點檢，封荊王，賜資忠保義奉國竭貞平亂功臣。

translations.literal: For his merit he was transferred to Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Front, enfeoffed as Prince of Jing, and granted the title Meritorious in Loyalty, Righteousness, Service to the State, Utter Devotion, and Pacification of Disorder.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was transferred to Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Front, enfeoffed as Prince of Jing, and granted the title Meritorious in Loyalty, Righteousness, Service to the State, Utter Devotion, and Pacification of Disorder.

sentences.zh: 咸雍二年，遷西南面招討使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianyong he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Xianyong reign he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 大康初，徙王吳，賜白海東青鶻。

translations.literal: Early in Dakang he was reassigned as Prince of Wu and granted a white sea gyrfalcon.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Dakang reign he was reassigned as Prince of Wu and granted a white sea gyrfalcon.

sentences.zh: 皇太子為乙辛誣構，幽於上京。

translations.literal: The crown prince was framed by Yixin and imprisoned at the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince was framed by Yelu Yixin and imprisoned at the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 韓家奴上書力言其冤，不報。

translations.literal: Hanjianu memorialized forcefully declaring his innocence, but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: Hanjianu memorialized forcefully declaring the prince's innocence, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 四年，復為西南面招討使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he again became Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he again became Pacification Commissioner of the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 例削一字王爵，改王蘭陵，薨。

translations.literal: By regulation his single-character princely title was reduced; he was reassigned as Prince of Lanling and died.
translations.idiomatic: By regulation his single-character princely title was reduced. He was reassigned as Prince of Lanling and died.

sentences.zh: 子楊九，終右祗候郎君班詳穩，贈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: His son Yangjiu ended as Xiangwen of the Right Attendant Gentlemen Class and was posthumously made Co-Director of the Secretariat Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yangjiu ended his career as Xiangwen of the Right Attendant Gentlemen Class and was posthumously made Co-Director of the Secretariat Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 蕭德，字特末隱，楮特部人。

translations.literal: Xiao De, style name Temoyin, was a man of the Chute Tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao De, whose style name was Temoyin, was a man of the Chute Tribe.

sentences.zh: 性和易，篤學好禮法。

translations.literal: His nature was easygoing; he was devoted to learning and loved ritual and law.
translations.idiomatic: He was easygoing by nature, devoted to learning, and fond of ritual and law.

sentences.zh: 太平中，領牌印、直宿，累遷北院樞密副使，敷奏詳明，多稱上旨。

translations.literal: During Taiping he was put in charge of seals and tally and night watch, rose through successive posts to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat, and in memorials was detailed and clear, often winning approval of the sovereign's intent.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping reign he was put in charge of seals and tally and night watch, rose through successive appointments to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat, and in memorials was detailed and clear, often winning approval of the sovereign's intent.

sentences.zh: 詔與林牙耶律庶成修《律令》，改契丹行宮都部署，賜宮戶十有五。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him together with Linya Yelu Shucheng to compile the Statutes and Ordinances; he was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace and granted fifteen palace households.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him and Linya Yelu Shucheng to compile the Statutes and Ordinances. He was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace and granted fifteen palace households.

sentences.zh: 清寧元年，遷同知北院樞密使，封魯國公。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingning he was transferred to co-administrator of the Northern Court Secretariat and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qingning reign he was transferred to co-administrator of the Northern Court Secretariat and enfeoffed as Duke of Lu.

sentences.zh: 上以德為先朝眷遇，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: Because the emperor regarded De as one favored by the previous reign, he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.
translations.idiomatic: Because the emperor regarded De as one favored by the previous reign, he was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.

sentences.zh: 五年，轉南京統軍使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital armies.

sentences.zh: 九年，復為南府宰相。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he again became Chancellor of the Southern Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he again became Chancellor of the Southern Office.

sentences.zh: 重元之亂，推鋒力戰，斬涅魯古首以獻，論功封漢王。

translations.literal: In Chongyuan's rebellion he led the van and fought hard, beheaded Nielugu and presented the head, and for his merit was enfeoffed as Prince of Han.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongyuan's rebellion he led the van and fought hard, beheaded Nielugu and presented the head, and for his merit was enfeoffed as Prince of Han.

sentences.zh: 咸雍初，以告老歸，優詔不許。

translations.literal: Early in Xianyong, on grounds of age he requested retirement and return home, but a gracious edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianyong reign, on grounds of age he requested retirement and return home, but a gracious edict did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 久之，加尚父，致仕。

translations.literal: After some time he was given the exalted title Imperial Father and retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was given the exalted title Imperial Father and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十二。

translations.literal: He died, aged seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 蕭惟信，字耶寧，楮特部人。

translations.literal: Xiao Weixin, style name Yening, was a man of the Chute Tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Weixin, whose style name was Yening, was a man of the Chute Tribe.

sentences.zh: 五世祖霞賴，南府宰相。

translations.literal: His fifth-generation ancestor Xialai was Chancellor of the Southern Office.
translations.idiomatic: His fifth-generation ancestor Xialai served as Chancellor of the Southern Office.

sentences.zh: 曾祖烏古，中書令。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Wugu was Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Wugu served as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 祖阿古只，知平州。

translations.literal: His grandfather Aguzhi was Administrator of Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Aguzhi served as Administrator of Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 父高八，多智數，博覽古今。

translations.literal: His father Gaoba was greatly resourceful and widely read in affairs ancient and modern.
translations.idiomatic: His father Gaoba was greatly resourceful and widely read in affairs ancient and modern.

sentences.zh: 開泰初，為北院承旨，稍遷右夷離畢，以幹敏稱，拜南府宰相。

translations.literal: Early in Kaitai he was Northern Court Secretariat Drafter, was gradually transferred to Right Yilibi, was known for capability and keenness, and was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kaitai reign he served as Northern Court Secretariat Drafter, was gradually transferred to Right Yilibi, was known for capability and keenness, and was appointed Chancellor of the Southern Office.

sentences.zh: 累遷倒塌嶺節度使，知興中府，復為右夷離畢。

translations.literal: He rose through successive posts to Military Commissioner of Daodaling, Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, and again Right Yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive appointments to Military Commissioner of Daodaling, Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, and again Right Yilibi.

sentences.zh: 陵青誘眾作亂，事覺，高八按之，止誅首惡，餘並釋之。

translations.literal: Lingqing incited the masses to rebellion; when the matter came to light, Gaoba investigated it, executed only the chief culprits, and released the rest.
translations.idiomatic: Lingqing incited the masses to rebellion. When the matter came to light, Gaoba investigated it, executed only the chief culprits, and released the rest.

sentences.zh: 歸奏，稱旨。

translations.literal: On returning he reported, and the emperor was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he reported, and the emperor was pleased.

sentences.zh: 惟信資沈毅，篤誌於學，能辨論。

translations.literal: Weixin was by nature steady and resolute, devoted in his pursuit of learning, and able in debate.
translations.idiomatic: Weixin was by nature steady and resolute, devoted in his pursuit of learning, and skilled in debate.

sentences.zh: 重熙初始仕，累遷左右丞。

translations.literal: He first entered office at the beginning of Chongxi and rose through successive posts to Left and Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: He first entered office at the beginning of the Chongxi reign and rose through successive appointments to Left and Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十五年，徙燕趙國王傅，帝諭之曰：「燕趙左右多面諛，不聞忠言，浸以成性。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred as Tutor to the Prince of Yan and Zhao; the emperor instructed him, saying, "Those about Yan and Zhao are mostly flatterers to the face; they do not hear loyal words, and this has gradually become their nature.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred as Tutor to the Prince of Yan and Zhao. The emperor instructed him, saying, "Those about the prince are mostly flatterers to his face. They do not hear loyal words, and this has gradually become their nature.

sentences.zh: 汝當以道規誨，使知君父之義。

translations.literal: You should instruct him in the Way and make him understand the obligations toward ruler and father.
translations.idiomatic: You should instruct him in the Way and make him understand the obligations owed to ruler and father.

sentences.zh: 有不可處王邸者，以名聞。」

translations.literal: If any cannot remain in the prince's residence, report their names."
translations.idiomatic: If anyone is unfit to remain in the prince's residence, report his name."

sentences.zh: 惟信輔導以禮。

translations.literal: Weixin guided and instructed him according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Weixin guided and instructed him according to ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 十七年，遷北院樞密副使，坐事免官。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat but was dismissed from office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat but was dismissed from office for an offense.

sentences.zh: 尋復職，兼北面林牙。

translations.literal: Before long he was restored to office and concurrently served as Northern Chancellor Linya.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was restored to office and concurrently served as Northern Chancellor Linya.

sentences.zh: 清寧九年，重元作亂，犯灤河行宮，惟信從耶律仁先破之，賜竭忠定亂功臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Qingning, when Chongyuan rebelled and attacked the traveling palace on the Luan River, Weixin followed Yelu Renxian in defeating him and was granted the title Meritorious in Utter Loyalty and Pacification of Disorder.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of the Qingning reign, when Chongyuan rebelled and attacked the traveling palace on the Luan River, Weixin followed Yelu Renxian in defeating him and was granted the title Meritorious in Utter Loyalty and Pacification of Disorder.

sentences.zh: 歷南京留守、左右夷離畢，復為北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: He served as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital, Left and Right Yilibi, and again as Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Garrison Commander of the Southern Capital, as Left and Right Yilibi, and again as Deputy Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 大康中，以老乞骸骨，不聽。

translations.literal: During Dakang, on grounds of age he requested retirement, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dakang reign, on grounds of age he requested retirement, but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 樞密使耶律乙辛譖廢太子，中外知其冤，無敢言者，惟信數廷爭，不得復。

translations.literal: The Secretariat Commissioner Yelu Yixin slandered and deposed the crown prince; within and without the court all knew his innocence, yet none dared speak; Weixin repeatedly argued in court but could not secure restoration.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat Commissioner Yelu Yixin slandered and deposed the crown prince. Within and without the court all knew the prince's innocence, yet none dared speak. Weixin repeatedly argued in court but could not secure his restoration.

sentences.zh: 告老，加守司徒，卒。

translations.literal: He announced his retirement, was given the honorific Defender Grandee, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He announced his retirement, was given the honorific Defender Grandee, and died.

sentences.zh: 蕭樂音奴，字婆丹，奚六部敞穩突呂不六世孫。

translations.literal: Xiao Leyinnu, style name Podan, was a sixth-generation descendant of the Xi Six Tribes Chieftain Tulubu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Leyinnu, whose style name was Podan, was a sixth-generation descendant of the Xi Six Tribes Chieftain Tulubu.

sentences.zh: 父拔剌，三歲居父母喪，毀瘠過甚，養於家奴奚列阿不。

translations.literal: His father Bala, at age three in mourning for his parents, wasted away excessively and was raised by the household slave Xilie Abu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bala, at age three while in mourning for his parents, wasted away excessively and was raised by the household slave Xilie Abu.

sentences.zh: 重熙初，興宗獵奚山，過拔剌所居，奚列阿不言於近臣，拔剌得見上。

translations.literal: Early in Chongxi, Emperor Xingzong hunted in the Xi mountains, passed Bala's dwelling, and Xilie Abu spoke to close ministers; Bala was able to see the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chongxi reign, Emperor Xingzong hunted in the Xi mountains and passed Bala's dwelling. Xilie Abu spoke to close ministers, and Bala was brought before the emperor.

sentences.zh: 年甫十歲，氣象如成人。

translations.literal: He was only ten years old, yet his bearing was like an adult's.
translations.idiomatic: He was only ten years old, yet his bearing was that of an adult.

sentences.zh: 帝悅之，錫賚甚厚。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased with him and bestowed gifts very generously.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased with him and bestowed gifts very generously.

sentences.zh: 既長，有遠誌，不樂仕進，隱於奚王嶺之插合谷。

translations.literal: When grown, he had far-reaching ambition, took no pleasure in advancing in office, and lived in seclusion in Chage Valley on the Xi Prince Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: When grown, he had far-reaching ambition, took no pleasure in advancing in office, and lived in seclusion in Chage Valley on the Xi Prince Ridge.

sentences.zh: 上以其名家，又有時譽，就拜舍利軍詳穩。

translations.literal: Because he came from a distinguished family and enjoyed contemporary renown, the emperor appointed him Xiangwen of the Sheli Army.
translations.idiomatic: Because he came from a distinguished family and enjoyed contemporary renown, the emperor appointed him Xiangwen of the Sheli Army.

sentences.zh: 樂音奴貌偉言辨，通遼、漢文字，善騎射擊鞠，所交皆一時名士。

translations.literal: Leyinnu was imposing in appearance and eloquent in speech, mastered Khitan and Chinese writing, was skilled at riding, archery, and cuju, and all he associated with were leading men of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Leyinnu was imposing in appearance and eloquent in speech, mastered Khitan and Chinese writing, was skilled at riding, archery, and cuju, and all his associates were leading men of the age.

sentences.zh: 年四十，始為護衛。

translations.literal: At age forty he first entered the guard corps.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of forty he first entered the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 平重元之亂，以功遷護衛太保，改本部南克，俄為旗鼓拽剌詳穩。

translations.literal: For pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion he was transferred to Grand Guardian of the Guard, transferred within his tribe to Southern Ke, and soon became Xiangwen of the Banner-and-Drum Zhuala Detachment.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Chongyuan's rebellion he was transferred to Grand Guardian of the Guard, transferred within his tribe to Southern Ke, and soon became Xiangwen of the Banner-and-Drum Zhuala Detachment.

sentences.zh: 監障海東青鶻，獲白花者十三，賜榾柮犀並玉吐鶻。

translations.literal: He supervised the barrier-sea gyrfalcons and obtained thirteen white birds; he was granted catalpa rhinoceros horn and a jade hawking bird.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised the barrier-sea gyrfalcons and obtained thirteen white birds. He was granted catalpa rhinoceros horn and a jade hawking bird.

sentences.zh: 拜五蕃部節度使，卒。

translations.literal: He was appointed Military Commissioner of the Five Fan Tribes and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Military Commissioner of the Five Fan Tribes and died.

sentences.zh: 子陽阿，有傳。

translations.literal: His son Yang'a has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yang'a has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 耶律敵烈，字撒懶，采訪使吼五世孫。

translations.literal: Yelu Dilie, style name Salan, was a fifth-generation descendant of the Investigation Commissioner Hou.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Dilie, whose style name was Salan, was a fifth-generation descendant of the Investigation Commissioner Hou.

sentences.zh: 寬厚好學，工文詞。

translations.literal: He was generous and magnanimous, fond of learning, and skilled in literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: He was generous and magnanimous, fond of learning, and skilled in literary composition.

sentences.zh: 重熙末，補牌印郎君，兼知起居註。

translations.literal: Late in Chongxi he was appointed Seal-and-Tally Attendant Gentleman and concurrently served as compiler of the Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Chongxi reign he was appointed Seal-and-Tally Attendant Gentleman and concurrently served as compiler of the Veritable Records.

sentences.zh: 清寧元年，稍遷同知永州事，禁盜有功，改北面林牙承旨。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qingning he was gradually transferred to co-administrator of Yongzhou affairs; for suppressing banditry he had merit and was made Northern Chancellor Linya Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Qingning reign he was gradually transferred to co-administrator of Yongzhou affairs. For suppressing banditry he earned merit and was made Northern Chancellor Linya Drafter.

sentences.zh: 九年，重元作亂，敵烈赴援，力戰平之，遙授臨海軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when Chongyuan rebelled, Dilie rushed to aid, fought hard to pacify the rebellion, and was appointed in absentia Military Commissioner of the Linhai Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when Chongyuan rebelled, Dilie rushed to aid, fought hard to pacify the rebellion, and was appointed in absentia Military Commissioner of the Linhai Army.

sentences.zh: 十年，徙武安州觀察使。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Wu'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Wu'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸雍五年，累遷長寧宮使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xianyong he rose through successive posts to Commissioner of the Changning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Xianyong reign he rose through successive appointments to Commissioner of the Changning Palace.

sentences.zh: 撿括戶部司乾州錢帛逋負，立出納經畫法，公私便之。

translations.literal: He audited arrears in money and silk owed to the Households Bureau at Qianzhou, established methods for receipts and disbursements, and both public and private affairs were made convenient.
translations.idiomatic: He audited arrears in money and silk owed to the Households Bureau at Qianzhou, established methods for receipts and disbursements, and both public and private affairs were made convenient.

sentences.zh: 大康四年，為南院大王。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Dakang he became Great King of the Southern Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Dakang reign he became Great King of the Southern Court.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，部民請留，同知南京留守事。

translations.literal: When his term ended, the people of his division asked that he remain, and he became co-administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, the people of his division asked that he remain, and he became co-administrator of the Southern Capital garrison command.

sentences.zh: 有疾，上命乘傳赴闕，遣太醫視之。

translations.literal: When he fell ill, the emperor ordered him to travel by relay post to court and sent the imperial physician to attend him.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill, the emperor ordered him to travel by relay post to court and sent the imperial physician to attend him.

sentences.zh: 遷上京留守。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 大安中，改塌母城節度使。

translations.literal: During Da'an he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Tamu City.
translations.idiomatic: During the Da'an reign he was transferred to Military Commissioner of Tamu City.

sentences.zh: 以疾致仕，加兼侍中，賜一品俸。

translations.literal: He retired on grounds of illness, was additionally made Vice Director of the Secretariat, and was granted first-rank salary.
translations.idiomatic: He retired on grounds of illness, was additionally made Vice Director of the Secretariat, and was granted first-rank salary.

sentences.zh: 八年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the eighth year.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighth year.

sentences.zh: 姚景行，始名景禧。

translations.literal: Yao Jingxing — his original name was Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Jingxing — his original name was Jingxi.

sentences.zh: 祖漢英，本周將，應歷初來聘，用敵國禮，帝怒，留之，隸漢人宮分。

translations.literal: His grandfather Hanying had been a general of the Later Zhou; early in Yingli he came on embassy and used the rites due an equal state; the emperor was angry, detained him, and assigned him to a Han palace household.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Hanying had been a general of the Later Zhou. Early in the Yingli reign he came on embassy and used the rites due an equal state. The emperor was angry, detained him, and assigned him to a Han palace household.

sentences.zh: 及景行既貴，始出籍，貫興中縣。

translations.literal: When Jingxing had risen high, he was first removed from the register and his domicile was entered as Xingzhong County.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingxing had risen high, he was first removed from the household register and his domicile was entered as Xingzhong County.

sentences.zh: 景行博學。

translations.literal: Jingxing was broadly learned.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxing was broadly learned.

sentences.zh: 重熙五年，擢進士乙科，為將作監，改燕趙國王教授。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongxi he was selected in the second rank of the jinshi examination, became Director of Palace Construction, and was transferred to Instructor to the Prince of Yan and Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Chongxi reign he was selected in the second rank of the jinshi examination, became Director of Palace Construction, and was transferred to Instructor to the Prince of Yan and Zhao.

sentences.zh: 不數年，至翰林學士，樞密副使，參知政事。

translations.literal: Within a few years he reached Hanlin Academician, Deputy Commissioner of the Secretariat, and Participant in Government.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years he reached Hanlin Academician, Deputy Commissioner of the Secretariat, and Participant in Government.

sentences.zh: 性敦厚廉直，人望歸之。

translations.literal: By nature he was sincere, generous, and upright, and public esteem turned to him.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was sincere, generous, and upright, and public esteem turned to him.

sentences.zh: 道宗即位，多被顧問，為北府宰相。

translations.literal: When Emperor Daozong ascended the throne, he was often consulted and became Chancellor of the Northern Office.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daozong ascended the throne, he was often consulted and became Chancellor of the Northern Office.

sentences.zh: 九年秋，告歸，道聞重元亂，收集行旅，得三百餘騎勤王。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the ninth year he requested leave to return home; on the road he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, gathered his traveling companions, and obtained more than three hundred horsemen to aid the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the ninth year he requested leave to return home. On the road he heard of Chongyuan's rebellion, gathered his traveling companions, and mustered more than three hundred horsemen to aid the throne.

sentences.zh: 比至，賊已平。

translations.literal: By the time he arrived, the rebels had already been pacified.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he arrived, the rebels had already been pacified.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其忠，賜以逆人財產。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his loyalty and granted him the property of the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his loyalty and granted him the property of the rebels.

sentences.zh: 咸雍元年，出為武定軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianyong he was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Xianyong reign he was sent out as Military Commissioner of the Wuding Army.

sentences.zh: 明年，驛召拜南院樞密使。

translations.literal: The next year he was summoned by relay post and appointed Commissioner of the Southern Court Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was summoned by relay post and appointed Commissioner of the Southern Court Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 上從容問治道，引入內殿，出御書及太子書示之，賜什器車仗。

translations.literal: The emperor at leisure asked him about the way of governance, brought him into the inner hall, produced imperial writings and the crown prince's writings to show him, and granted household goods, carriages, and equipment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at leisure asked him about the way of governance, brought him into the inner hall, produced imperial writings and the crown prince's writings to show him, and granted household goods, carriages, and equipment.

sentences.zh: 帝有意伐宋，召景行問曰：「宋人好生邊事，如何？」

translations.literal: The emperor intended to attack Song and summoned Jingxing to ask, "The Song are fond of provoking border affairs — what of it?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor intended to attack Song and summoned Jingxing to ask, "The Song are fond of provoking border affairs — what do you advise?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「自聖宗皇帝以威德懷遠，宋修職貢，迨今幾六十年。

translations.literal: He replied, "Since Emperor Shengzong won the distant by majesty and virtue, Song has maintained tribute duties — down to today it is nearly sixty years.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Since Emperor Shengzong won the distant by majesty and virtue, Song has maintained tribute duties. Down to today that has been nearly sixty years.

sentences.zh: 若以細故用兵，恐違先帝成約。」

translations.literal: If we use arms over a trifling matter, I fear we will violate the late emperor's settled agreement."
translations.idiomatic: If we use arms over a trifling matter, I fear we will violate the late emperor's settled agreement."

sentences.zh: 上然其言而止。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words and desisted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words and abandoned the plan.

sentences.zh: 致仕，不逾月復舊職。

translations.literal: He retired from office, but within a month was restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: He retired from office, but within a month was restored to his former post.

sentences.zh: 丁家艱，起復，兼中書令。

translations.literal: He entered mourning for a parent, was recalled from mourning, and concurrently served as Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He entered mourning for a parent, was recalled from mourning, and concurrently served as Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 上問古今儒士優劣，占對稱旨，知興中府，改朔方軍節度使。

translations.literal: The emperor asked about the relative merits of Confucian scholars ancient and modern; his divinatory reply pleased the emperor, and he was made Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, then transferred to Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked about the relative merits of Confucian scholars ancient and modern. His reply pleased the emperor, and he was made Administrator of Xingzhong Prefecture, then transferred to Military Commissioner of the Shuofang Army.

sentences.zh: 大康初，徙鎮遼興。

translations.literal: Early in Dakang he was transferred to garrison Liaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Dakang reign he was transferred to garrison Liaoxing.

sentences.zh: 以上京多滯獄，命為留守，不數月，以獄空聞。

translations.literal: Because the Supreme Capital had many cases held in detention, he was appointed Garrison Commander; within a few months it was reported that the prisons were empty.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Supreme Capital had many cases held in detention, he was appointed Garrison Commander. Within a few months it was reported that the prisons were empty.

sentences.zh: 累乞致政，不從。

translations.literal: He repeatedly requested retirement, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly requested retirement, but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 復請，許之，加守太師。

translations.literal: He requested again and was permitted; he was given the honorific Defender Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: He requested again and was permitted. He was given the honorific Defender Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 卒，遣使吊祭，追封柳城郡王，謚文憲。

translations.literal: He died; envoys were sent with condolences and libations; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liucheng with posthumous title Wenxian.
translations.idiomatic: He died. Envoys were sent with condolences and libations. He was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Liucheng with the posthumous title Wenxian.

sentences.zh: 壽隆五年，詔為立祠。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shoulong an edict ordered a shrine erected for him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Shoulong reign an edict ordered a shrine erected for him.

sentences.zh: 耶律阿思，字撒班。

translations.literal: Yelu Asi, style name Saban.
translations.idiomatic: Yelu Asi, whose style name was Saban.

sentences.zh: 清寧初，補祗候郎君。

translations.literal: Early in Qingning he was appointed Attendant Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qingning reign he was appointed Attendant Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 以善射，掌獵事，進渤海近侍詳穩。

translations.literal: Because he was skilled at archery he managed hunting affairs and was promoted to Xiangwen of the Bohai Close Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was skilled at archery he managed hunting affairs and was promoted to Xiangwen of the Bohai Close Attendants.

sentences.zh: 重元之亂，與護衛蘇射殺涅魯古，賜號靖亂功臣，徙契丹行宮都部署。

translations.literal: In Chongyuan's rebellion he together with the guard Su shot and killed Nielugu, was granted the title Meritorious in Quelling Disorder, and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongyuan's rebellion he and the guard Su shot and killed Nielugu, was granted the title Meritorious in Quelling Disorder, and was transferred to Garrison Commander of the Khitan Traveling Palace.

sentences.zh: 大安初，為北院大王，封漆水郡王。

translations.literal: Early in Da'an he became Great King of the Northern Court and was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Da'an reign he became Great King of the Northern Court and was enfeoffed as Prince of Qishui.

sentences.zh: 壽隆元年，為北院樞密使，監修國史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shoulong he became Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat and supervised compilation of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Shoulong reign he became Commissioner of the Northern Court Secretariat and supervised compilation of the national history.

sentences.zh: 道宗崩，受顧命，加於越。

translations.literal: When Emperor Daozong died he received the final imperial command and was given the title yuyue.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Daozong died he received the dying edict and was given the title yuyue.

sentences.zh: 錄乙辛黨人，罪重者當籍其家，阿思受賂，多所寬貰。

translations.literal: When Yixin's partisans were registered, those whose crimes were grave should have had their households confiscated, but Asi took bribes and pardoned many.
translations.idiomatic: When Yixin's partisans were registered, those whose crimes were grave should have had their households confiscated, but Asi took bribes and pardoned many.

sentences.zh: 蕭合魯嘗言當修邊備，阿思力沮其事，或譏其以金賣國。

translations.literal: Xiao Helu once said that frontier defenses should be strengthened, but Asi strenuously blocked the proposal, and some mocked him for selling the state for gold.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Helu once argued that frontier defenses should be strengthened, but Asi strenuously blocked the proposal, and some mocked him for selling the state for gold.

sentences.zh: 後以風疾失音，致仕，加尚父，封趙王。

translations.literal: Later, because of wind disorder he lost his voice, retired from office, was given the exalted title Imperial Father, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Later he lost his voice to wind disorder, retired from office, was given the exalted title Imperial Father, and was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 薨，年八十，追封齊國王。

translations.literal: He died, aged eighty, and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of eighty and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 論曰：灤河之變，重元擁兵行幄，微仁先等，道宗其危乎！

translations.literal: The commentators say: At the Luan River crisis, Chongyuan held troops against the traveling encampment — but for Renxian and the others, would not Emperor Daozong have been in peril!
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: At the Luan River crisis, Chongyuan held troops against the traveling encampment. But for Renxian and the others, would not Emperor Daozong have been in peril!

sentences.zh: 當其止幸北、南院，召塔剌兵以靖大難，功宜居首。

translations.literal: When he halted the imperial progress to the Northern and Southern courts and summoned Tala's troops to settle the great crisis, his merit should rank first.
translations.idiomatic: When he halted the imperial progress to the Northern and Southern courts and summoned Tala's troops to settle the great crisis, his merit should rank first.

sentences.zh: 良以反謀白太后，韓家奴以逆順降奚人，德與阿思殺涅魯古，皆有討賊之力焉。

translations.literal: Liang reported the plot of rebellion to the Empress Dowager; Hanjianu by distinguishing loyalty and rebellion caused the Xi to submit; De and Asi killed Nielugu — all had the power to suppress the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Liang reported the plot of rebellion to the Empress Dowager; Hanjianu, by distinguishing loyalty from rebellion, caused the Xi to submit; Xiao De and Yelu Asi killed Nielugu — all contributed force to the suppression of the rebels.

sentences.zh: 仁先齊名休哥，勛德兼備，此其一節歟！

translations.literal: Renxian ranks with Xiuge in fame; merit and virtue together complete — is this not one proof of it!
translations.idiomatic: Renxian ranks with Yelu Xiuge in fame; merit and virtue together complete — is this not one proof of it!
